howToPlay.title: How to Play
howToPlay.step1Body: Tap a card to flip it, then tap a second card. Find the matching pair.
howToPlay.step2Body: Same pictures disappear. Different pictures flip back — then try again.
howToPlay.step3Body: Clear every pair before time runs out. Faster clears earn more stars.
howToPlay.step4Body: Buy Reveal, Extra Time, and Lucky Clover in the Shop to help on tough levels.

legal.title: Terms & Privacy
legal.termsContent:
Last updated: August 2026

These Terms of Service apply to Memora ("the game"), published by Vraxion.

1. Acceptance
By downloading, installing, or using Memora, you agree to these Terms. If you do not agree, please do not use the game.

2. License
We grant you a limited, non-exclusive, non-transferable license to use the game for personal, non-commercial entertainment on your own devices.

3. Guest account
Memora uses a guest profile created on your device. You may set a display name for leaderboards. There is no email or social login. Uninstalling the app or clearing app data may permanently remove your guest profile and local progress.

4. Virtual items & purchases
Coins, coin packs, boosts (such as hammer, change fruit, swap, size increase, and undo), and Remove Ads are virtual items or entitlements with no real-world cash value and cannot be redeemed for money. In-app purchases are processed by Apple App Store or Google Play (and related billing partners such as RevenueCat). Purchases are generally final subject to the store's refund rules. We may change, balance, or remove virtual items at any time.

5. Ads
The game may show advertisements unless you purchase Remove Ads. Ad networks may collect device and advertising identifiers according to their own policies and applicable consent screens.

6. Fair play
You agree not to cheat, exploit bugs, manipulate scores or leaderboards, harass others, or use the game in any way that violates applicable laws.

7. Leaderboards & sharing
Memora is a single-player game. Scores you submit may appear on public leaderboards with your display name. You may share your score through your device's share sheet; that share is not uploaded by us beyond what the OS share action requires.

8. Changes
We may update these terms from time to time. Continued use of the game after changes constitutes acceptance of the updated terms.

9. Contact
Questions about these terms: support@vraxion.com
legal.privacyContent:
Last updated: August 2026

This Privacy Policy describes how Memora ("the game"), published by Vraxion, handles information.

1. Information we collect
• Guest profile: a guest ID and secure token created for your install, plus an optional display name.
• Gameplay on our servers: scores and related play metadata (such as session duration and merge counts) submitted for leaderboards.
• Device & notifications (when enabled): platform (iOS/Android), language/locale, and push notification token.
• On your device only: coins, boost inventory, missions, daily rewards, in-progress game saves, settings (sound, music, language), and local high score.
• Analytics events (when enabled): session and gameplay events such as game start/over, purchases, ad rewards, daily claims, and mission completion. We may associate analytics with your guest ID.
• Advertising & consent (when ads are shown): advertising identifiers and consent status via platforms such as Google AdMob, including ATT on iOS and applicable consent prompts.

We do not require your email address or social account to play.

2. How we use information
We use this information to run the game, maintain your guest session, show leaderboards, deliver push or local reminders (for example daily rewards or rank updates), process in-app purchases, show or suppress ads, improve the product, and respond to support requests.

3. Where data is stored
Coins, boosts, missions, daily rewards, in-progress game saves, and most settings stay on your device. Guest credentials, display name, scores (with related play metadata), and device push tokens may be stored on our servers so leaderboards and notifications work across sessions. Clearing app data or uninstalling may delete local data and your guest link on that device.

4. Third-party services
Depending on build and settings, the game may use:
• Google AdMob (ads and privacy/consent tooling)
• Firebase Analytics
• Firebase Cloud Messaging (push notifications)
• RevenueCat and Apple / Google in-app billing (purchases)
• Device share and in-app review features provided by the OS

Each provider processes data under its own privacy policy.

5. Children's privacy
The game is not directed at children under 13. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13. If you believe a child has provided such information, contact us and we will take appropriate steps.

6. Your rights
Depending on your region, you may request access to, correction of, or deletion of personal data associated with your guest profile by contacting support@vraxion.com. Store purchases and refunds are handled through Apple or Google.

7. Changes
We may update this privacy policy from time to time. Significant changes will be communicated through the app or our website (for example memora.vraxion.com).

8. Contact
Privacy questions: support@vraxion.com
